newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Davids dips on AIW expansion plan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Davids dips on AIW expansion plan.

text.p: The shares of grocery wholesaler and retailer Davids Ltd fell in early trade on Tuesday as investors guaged the impact of plans announced by Woolworths Ltd on Monday to expand its Australian Independant Wholesalers Pty Ltd (AIW) unit.
At 10.40 a.m. (2340 GMT), Davids shares were nine cents or 5.4 percent weaker at A$1.57 on turnover of 211,860 shares.
"The increase in competition (from AIW) would certainly question Davids' ability to maintain its market share," a Sydney-based dealer said.

Woolworths said on Monday it intended to expand AIW's operations, which are currently based in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT), into New South Wales and Queensland, and would consider Victoria further down the track.
Woolworths acquired AIW last year when it bought out the Cannons Foodstore chain in the ACT.
